text:
Lena (CSM): Morning team — starting HarborView onboarding thread. Objective: embed Redwood embeddings + semantic search into HarborView web UI for 2026-06-10 launch. Need clear owners for SSO, data mapping, sample dataset prep, and customer enablement. Who can take what?
Omar (Eng): I can own SSO + staging deployment. Question: do they require IdP-initiated SAML or just SP-initiated SSO? Aiming to have staging up by 2026-05-05.
Sofia (Solutions): Ill lead enablement and the runbook. Will include: API key rotation, embedding batch scripts, validation queries, and rollback instructions. Draft runbook at https://redwood.example/harborview-runbook (will replace with customer link).
Tom (HarborView PM): From our side, success metrics: +15% search CTR, median request latency <500ms, and zero P0 incidents in first 30 days. Compliance: logs retained max 30 days, and customer data cannot be stored in raw form.
Lena (CSM): Thanks. Proposed 30/60/90: 0-30d = access, sample data ingest, and 1 workshop; 31-60d = pilot with 10% traffic + weekly check-ins; 61-90d = ramp to target cohort and handoff to support. Renewal risk trigger: adoption <30% at day 60 or error rate >5% moves account to at-risk.
Omar (Eng): Noted technical risk: HarborView runs strict egress rules and uses a corporate proxy. We need firewall and SNAT details. Ill add a minimal egress snippet for their infra team to the runbook: 
```
# example outbound rule (replace IP with Redwood edge IPs)
ufw allow out to 34.123.210.45 port 443 proto tcp
```
Sofia (Solutions): Also recommending a short tagging scheme for embeddings (namespace: harborview_prod / harborview_pilot) and a mapping sheet for user-visible fields. Ill create the mapping template and a 2-question feedback survey for post-pilot.
onboard-bot: Workshop scheduled: HarborView onboarding workshop 12026-04-22 14:00-15:00 PT. Calendar invites sent.
Tom (HarborView PM): Workshop confirmed. Well provide a sanitized sample dataset by 2026-04-18 and a small acceptance test plan (5 golden queries).
Lena (CSM): Owners summary: Omar = SSO & staging (ETA 2026-05-05), Sofia = enablement + runbook (draft ETA 2026-04-20), Tom = sample dataset & acceptance tests (ETA 2026-04-18). Ill run weekly status notes here and set a 14-day renewal-risk review two weeks before pilot end.
Omar (Eng): I'll instrument metrics (median/p95 latency, error rate, successful embeddings per min) and push dashboards to Console > Projects > HarborView. Will also add estimated token cost per 1k requests.
Sofia (Solutions): Enablement plan: 1x 60-min workshop, 2x 30-min office hours during pilot, one dry-run cutover. Ill prepare a one-page ops playbook for their support team (incident triage, escalation paths, quick rollback).
Tom (HarborView PM): One ask from execs: a condensed one-page summary they can share with CTO. Sofia, can you deliver a PDF summary after the workshop? :eyes:
Sofia (Solutions): Yes. Ill attach it to the shared drive and post link here.
Lena (CSM): Good momentum. Risks & mitigations: 1) SSO delays > mitigation: allow temporary API key access for pilot. 2) Latency spikes > mitigation: model fallback to smaller quantized variant + increased caching. 3) Low adoption > mitigation: targeted in-app prompts and product messaging.
Tom (HarborView PM): Agree. Well commit a product engineer to monitor adoption signals for the first 30 days.
Lena (CSM): Next steps checklist (quick): 
- Omar: staging + SSO metadata (ETA 2026-05-05)
- Sofia: runbook draft + ops one-pager (ETA 2026-04-20)
- Tom: sanitized dataset + acceptance tests (ETA 2026-04-18)
Ill post a 7-day checkpoint summary in this thread. Thanks everyone! :sparkles:
